text.p: European Union monetary affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Thursday he planned to propose the EU's statistical office, Eurostat, become fully independent.

"I will ask the Intergovernmental Conference (IGC) to put an article in the Treaty...on the independence of Eurostat," he told journalists. He was in London for a series of meetings with politicians, authorities and businessmen.
Eurostat is the pan-European statistics office and is officially part of the European Commission at present.
